snippet.title: Hela Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Developers Windup provided a window into the whimsical world of Hela during the Future Games Show Summer Showcase. It’s a co-operative adventure game starring brave little mice, and it’s coming soon to PC, PlayStation and Xbox. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #hela

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
